summary: Adds a helper that shells out to ImageMagick to thumbnail uploads, a docs URL setting, and a /calc endpoint that evaluates a query expression.

findings.title: Request query evaluated as JavaScript
findings.problem: The /calc handler passes req.query.expr straight into eval. The added comments switch off the checks that would flag it.
findings.consequence: Any caller can run arbitrary code on the server process. That caller can read secrets, files and environment variables.
findings.fix: Remove eval and parse the expression with a restricted arithmetic evaluator. Reject input that holds anything besides digits, operators, parentheses and spaces.

findings.title: Shell command built from upload name
findings.problem: make_thumbnail interpolates upload_name into a command string and runs it through a shell. The docstring says the name comes from the upload form.
findings.consequence: An uploader can pick a name with shell metacharacters and run any command on the host. A name with '../' also reads or writes files outside the upload and thumbnail folders.
findings.fix: Pass an argument list to subprocess.run without shell=True. Also reduce upload_name to its basename or reject names containing path separators.

findings.title: New behaviour has no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds make_thumbnail and the /calc endpoint. No test exercises either one.
findings.consequence: Regressions or unsafe inputs in these paths go unnoticed until production.
findings.fix: Add tests for make_thumbnail with hostile names and for /calc with valid and malicious expressions.
